y-m-80-05.topic: Denderedzwa ramakumi matanhatu ganji akagadzirwa nemapfupa okudenga nemapazi ensimbi
y-m-80-05.goal: Tarisa uye gadzirisa kufungidzira kwekutanga (mazita ose 120 anoshandiswa) nedata idzva, gadzira iwe pachako mapeya asingashandiswi, uye utsanangure kuti sei denderedzwa riri makore 60 uchishandisa hukama hwemadenderedzwa maviri.
y-m-80-05.material:
Karenda yekare yaipa gore rega rega zita rinonzi 'ganji'. Mapfupa okudenga 10 (갑 을 병 정 무 기 경 신 임 계) nemapazi ensimbi 12 (자 축 인 묘 진 사 오 미 신 유 술 해) rimwe nerimwe rinotenderera nenhevedzano uye rinoitwa peya imwe pagore, saka mazita anofamba danho rimwe pagore: 갑자, 을축, 병인, 정묘, ... Kana mapfupa apera, anodzoka ku 갑, uye kana mapazi apera, anodzoka ku 자. Nhamba ndi 갑=1, 을=2, ..., 계=10, 자=1, 축=2, ..., 해=12.
Minseo akati, "Pane mazita 10×12=120, saka richadzoka kuzita rekutanga 갑자 chete mushure mokushandisa mazita ose 120."

y-m-80-11.title: Kana ukaisa fifths 12 pamusoro pemumwe, unowana ma octaves chaizvo here?
y-m-80-11.topic: Musical scales nema powers: perfect fifths dzakaiswa pamusoro pemumwe dzinosangana ne octave here?
y-m-80-11.goal: Enzanisa saizi dzema powers kuratidza kuti chirevo che '12 fifths = 7 octaves' hachishande chaizvo, nzwisisa gakava re odd-even rinotsanangura izvi pfupi, uye uenzanise nzira mbiri dzekugadzirisa mukugadzira zviridzwa.
y-m-80-11.material:
Pitch yenzwi inogona kutaurwa ne frequency, uye hukama hwema pitch maviri hunoenzaniswa ne ratio yema frequencies avo. Mu theory yekare, 'perfect fifth' ine frequency ratio ye3:2 (nzwi repamusoro nguva 1.5), uye kusimudza nzwi neoctave imwe kunowedzera frequency yayo kaviri. Vamwe vaitenda kuti kana ukaisa perfect fifths 12 kumusoro kubva panzwi, unopfuura nenzwi dzose 12 uye unodzoka kunzwi rimwe chete rakakwirira ne7 octaves.
Seou akati, "(3/2) yakawedzerwa ka12 ichaenzana chaizvo ne2 yakawedzerwa ka7. Ipapo keyboard inovhara zvakakwana." (3/2 ndi three halves, uye 2⁷ ndi2 yakawedzerwa ka7, ndiko 128)

y-m-80-07.title: Sei kuwanza nekupatsanura nehafu nekuita kaviri kuchishanda?
y-m-80-07.topic: Mutemo wenzira yekare yekuwanza (kuwanza nekupatsanura nehafu nekuita kaviri)
y-m-80-07.goal: Wana mutsetse apo mutemo wakashandiswa zvisizvo mumhinduro yenzira yekare yekuwanza, uye ushandise chikonzero chekuti mutemo unoshanda (nhamba yekuruboshwe inopatsanurwa kuita huwandu hwema powers e 2) kugadzira iwe pachako nhamba yekutanga inogutsa mamiriro uye uitsanangure.
y-m-80-07.material:
Iyi i nzira yekuwanza yakashandiswa munzvimbo dzakawanda kare. Nyora nhamba mbiri A ne B dzinofanira kuwanzwa mumakoramu maviri. Kuruboshwe, tanga kubva ku A uye uramba uchipatsanura nehafu (uchirasa zvakasara) kusvika wasvika ku 1, uye kurudyi, tanga kubva ku B uye uramba uchiita kaviri. Chengeta mitsetse chete apo nhamba yekuruboshwe i odd, uye uwedzere nhamba dzese dzekurudyi mumitsetse iyoyo kuwana A×B.
Muenzaniso: 23×14
Kuruboshwe 23, kurudyi 14 (mutsetse odd)
Kuruboshwe 11, kurudyi 28 (mutsetse odd)
Kuruboshwe 5, kurudyi 56 (mutsetse odd)
Kuruboshwe 2, kurudyi 112 (mutsetse even)
Kuruboshwe 1, kurudyi 224 (mutsetse odd)
14+28+56+224 = 322 = 23×14
Seoyun akaedza kugadzirisa 26×15 nenzira iyi.

y-m-80-06.title: Mutemo wokuti 'gore rinoparadzaniki ne 4 gore rokuwedzera' unogara uri wakarurama here?
y-m-80-06.topic: Mutemo wegore rokuwedzera rekarenda yeGregorian nenhambwe yegore repakati
y-m-80-06.goal: Ziva kuti makore mashoma anowirirana nomutemo haavimbisi mutemo wose, tsvaga iwe pachako makore apo mutemo unoputsika, uye utonge nokuverenga kuti mitemo yokunze inochinja sei kureba kwegore repakati.
y-m-80-06.material:
Mukarenda yatinoshandisa (karenda yeGregorian), gore rokuwedzera igore umo Kukadzi kune mazuva 29. Mutemo ndi: ① Gore rinoparadzaniki ne 4 igore rokuwedzera. ② Pakati pamwe, gore rinoparadzaniki ne 100 hariri gore rokuwedzera (gore rakajairika). ③ Pakati pamwe, gore rinoparadzaniki ne 400 igore rokuwedzera zvakare.
Jia haana kuziva mitemo ② ne ③ uye akati, "Gore rinoparadzaniki ne 4 igore rokuwedzera. 2020, 2024, ne 2028 ose makore okuwedzera. Saka mutemo uyu unogara uri wakarurama!"
y-m-80-06.thinking.1: Kutsvaga muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako mukati memhando
y-m-80-06.s.s1.prompt: Chokwadi chokuti 2020, 2024, ne 2028, zvakapiwa naJia, makore okuwedzera chinotsigira sei mutemo wokuti 'gore rinoparadzaniki ne 4 rinogara riri gore rokuwedzera'?
y-m-80-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga uye unyore zvakafanana pakati pemakore matatu akatariswa naJia.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza gore risingabatani izvi (semuenzaniso, gore i multiple ye 4 uye zvakare multiple ye 100) uye uedze mutemo.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.o.a: Makore ese matatu anoenderana, saka tinogona kutaura kuti mutemo uyu wakarurama kumakore ese.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakatora mienzaniso mishoma inoenderana sehumbowo hwemutemo wose.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.o.b: I chinhu chinouya makore 4 ega ega, saka hapana exception, uye mutemo unogara wakarurama.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti hapana exception nekuti mutemo unodzokororwa makore 4 ega ega.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.o.c: Tinofanira kutaura kuti leap year i tsika yekarenda, saka i mutemo usingagone kuedzwa nenhamba.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya kuti ma leap years anosarudzwa nemutemo wakagadzikana. Mamiriro emutemo anogona kuedzwa nenhamba.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.o.d: Makore matatu akafanana chete ndiwo akatariswa, saka tinofanirawo kuedza mamwe makore, sema multiples e 100.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i pfungwa yekuwana nekuedza makore akasiyana muhunhu nemakore akaedzwa.
y-m-80-06.s.s1.explain: Hapana pamakore matatu i multiple ye 100. Kana ukatarisa makore marudzi akafanana chete, haugone kuziva kana mutemo uchiputsika mugore rakasiyana.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.prompt: Wana makore 3 akasiyana pakati pe 1600 ne 2400 apo mutemo waJia (gore rinopatsanurika ne 4 i leap year) unoti i ma leap years asi ari ma common years pasi pemitemo iri pamusoro.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora makore anopatsanurika ne 4 anopatsanurikawo ne 100.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.hint.1: Pakati pemakore awakanyora, bvisa makore anopatsanurikawo ne 400, uye utarise makore anosara.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Gore rinofanira kuva natural number kubva ku 1600 kusvika ku 2400.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.ok.c2: I leap year pasi pemutemo waJia.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Gore iri harina kupatsanurika ne 4, saka mutemo waJia haudaidzi kuti i leap year zvakare.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.ok.c3: I common year pasi pemitemo iri pamusoro. I gore apo mutemo waJia wakaipa.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Gore iri i leap year pasi pemitemo iri pamusoro zvakare. Unoda chikonzero chekuti sei richipatsanurika ne 4 asi i common year.
y-m-80-06.s.s2.explain: Munguva iyi, makore apo mutemo waJia wakaipa i 1700, 1800, 1900, 2100, 2200, ne 2300. 2000, 1600, ne 2400 anopatsanurika ne 400, saka i ma leap years zvakare.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.prompt: Nemitemo iri pamusoro, pane ma leap years mangani pamwe chete mumakore 400 (semuenzaniso, kubva ku 1601 kusvika ku 2000)? Nemutengo uyu, hurefu hwegore repakati i 365 + (huwandu hwema leap years ÷ 400) mazuva. (Kana ukashandisa mutemo waJia chete, i 100 mumakore 400.)
y-m-80-06.s.s3.hint.0: Wana huwandu hwema multiples e 4, ema multiples e 100, nema multiples e 400 mumakore 400.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa mitemo ① kusvika ③ nenhevedzano uye unyore expression inowedzera nekubvisa huwandu.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.a: Uyu i mhedzisiro yekuverenga ma multiples ese e 4 se ma leap years. Ma multiples e 100 anofanira kubviswa se ma common years.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.b: Wakaverenga nekubvisa ma multiples e 100 kubva kuma multiples e 4 uye wakawedzera ma multiples e 400 zvakare.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.c: Wakabvisa ma multiples e 100 se ma common years asi hauna kuratidza kuti ma multiples e 400 anova ma leap years zvakare.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.r.d: Wakachengeta ma multiples e 400 se ma common years zvakare uye wakabvisa imwe nguva.
y-m-80-06.s.s3.explain: Mumakore 400, pane ma multiples e 4 100, apo 4 i ma multiples e 100 (uye pavo, 1 i multiple ye 400). 100−4+1=97. Gore repakati i 365+97/400=365.2425 mazuva, iri padyo nechokwadi chaizvo che anenge 365.2422 mazuva kupfuura mutemo waJia (365.25 mazuva).

y-m-80-08.title: Ungagadzira sei bepa rinochengeta chimiro chimwechete kana rakachekwa nehafu?
y-m-80-08.topic: Hukuru hwemapepa ekopa (A series) nema rectangles akafanana
y-m-80-08.goal: Ziva kuti kuti bepa rive rakafanana mushure mekuchekwa nehafu, ratio yedivi refu nedivi pfupi inofanira kuva yakagadzikana, gadzira hukuru hwe integer hwakati wandei hunogutsa mamiriro aya zvakatenderedza, uye utsanangure kuti sei zvisingagone kuitwa chaizvo.
y-m-80-08.material:
Inozivikanwa kuti kana A4 copy paper yachekwa nehafu pakati pedivi rayo refu inova A5 yechimiro chimwechete, uye mapepa maviri e A3 ane chimiro chakafanana nepepa rimwe re A2. Pano 'chimiro chimwechete' zvinoreva kuti ma rectangles maviri akafanana, ndiko kuti, ratio yedivi refu nedivi pfupi i imwechete. (Divi refu l nedivi pfupi w re rectangle, mu mm)
Seojin akashamisika, "Kana photo print paper ine chimiro che 3:2 yachekwa nehafu, haizochengeti chimiro chimwechete here?"

y-m-80-08.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi yemapepa anotevera inova rectangle yakafanana nepepa rekutanga kana divi refu rachekwa nehafu? (Siya kukanganisa kuri pasi pe decimal point.)
y-m-80-08.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora divi refu nedivi pfupi rechidimbu chakachekwa nehafu.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa divi refu ÷ divi pfupi re rectangle imwe neimwe nedivi refu ÷ divi pfupi rechidimbu.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti chimiro che 3:2 chinoshandawo. Nyora upamhi nekureba kwechidimbu chakachekwa nehafu uye uenzanise ma ratios.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti rectangle ine musiyano mudiki pakati peupamhi nekureba i yakagadzikana. Ienzanise neratio yechidimbu chakachekwa.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.c: Kufunga uku kwakafungidzira kuti zviri nyore kucheka kana divi refu i ka2 yedivi pfupi. Funga kuti chidimbu chakachekwa nehafu chine chimiro chipi.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.r.d: Kufunga uku kwakagadzira zvidimbu uye kwakaenzanisa ma ratios. Chidimbu chakachekwa chinova 177mm ne 250mm, uye ma ratios maviri anenge akaenzana.
y-m-80-08.s.s1.explain: Kune bepa rine divi refu l nedivi pfupi w, kana l yachekwa nehafu, chidimbu chine divi refu w nedivi pfupi l/2. Kuti dzive dzakafanana, l/w = w/(l/2) inodiwa, saka l² = 2w², ndiko kuti, l/w = √2 ≈ 1.414. Kune 250×354, 354/250 = 1.416, iyo i padyo zvikuru ne √2.
y-m-80-08.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pemapepa apo divi refu l (mm) nedivi pfupi w (mm) zvose i natural numbers uye w i kubva ku 100 kusvika ku 500, gadzira hukuru 3 ne w dzakasiyana dzine chimiro chinenge chakafanana kunyange kana divi refu rachekwa nehafu. y-m-80-08.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga l÷w ne l ne w dzawakasarudza uye utarise kana musiyano ne √2 uri mukati me 0.007.

y-m-80-08.s.s2.fail.c1: l ne w zvinofanira kuva natural numbers uye w inofanira kuva kubva ku 100 kusvika ku 500.

y-m-80-09.title: Kana pane check digit, inogona kubata kukanganisa kwese kwekunyora here?
y-m-80-09.topic: Check digit yenhamba yebhuku (ISBN) nekuwana kukanganisa
y-m-80-09.goal: Tarisa nemienzaniso kuti marudzi api ekukanganisa kwekupinza check digit inobata zvechokwadi uye marudzi api anogona kusiya, uye utsanangure muganhu wayo nekugadzira iwe pachako chiitiko chainosiya.
y-m-80-09.material:
International Standard Book Number (ISBN-13) iri kumashure kwebhuku i madhijiti 13. Wanza madhijiti 12 ekutanga nenhevedzano ne 1, 3, 1, 3, ... uye uawedzere ese kuwana S, uye dhijiti ye 13 (check digit) i dhijiti kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 9 inoita kuti huwandu hwese huve multiple ye 10 kana yawedzerwa ku S.
Muenzaniso (nhamba yakagadzirwa): kana madhijiti 12 ekutanga i 9 7 8 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9, saka S = 9×1+7×3+8×1+1×3+2×1+3×3+4×1+5×3+6×1+7×3+8×1+9×3 = 133, uye check digit i 7 (133+7=140).
Seojin akati, "Sezvo pane check digit, kana ukanyora nhamba zvisizvo, inogona kubata kukanganisa kwese!"

y-m-80-09.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga zvishoma nezve zvinoitwa ne check digit. Edza chaizvo kana kukanganisa kwedhijiti imwe kunobatwa.

y-m-80-09.s.s1.r.d: Mubasa iri mutemo wakasimbiswa. Wakasiya kuti unogona kuuwana nemutemo wakapiwa.

y-m-80-12.goal: Uchishandisa chokwadi chokuti mwedzi wemwedzi (unenge mazuva 29.53) negore (rinenge mazuva 365.24) hazvisi kuwanda kwenhamba dzizere kwomumwe nomumwe, fungidzira chikamu chemwedzi yokuwedzera, enzanisa kukanganisa kunounganidzwa kwakadini, uye usarudze mutemo wakanaka zvikuru uine zvikonzero.
y-m-80-12.material:
Karenda yomwedzi inotora denderedzwa rimwe chete rechimiro chomwedzi (rinenge mazuva 29.53059) semwedzi mumwe. Mwaka, kune rimwe divi, unofanira kuenderana negore rinotorwa kutenderera zuva (rinenge mazuva 365.2422). Mwedzi 12 ndi 12×29.53059≈mazuva 354.367, ayo anenge mazuva 10.9 pasi gore rega rega.
